Meet Laverne

Some little souls have to fight harder than others just to get their chance at a happy life. Laverne’s story began when she and her sister, Shirley, were dropped off at a shelter in Georgia while fighting the frightening effects of parvo.

These two little girls faced a difficult start, but they deserve so much more than the circumstances they were born into. Laverne is ready to leave that uncertain beginning behind and discover all the wonderful things puppyhood should bring: a loving family, cozy naps, playful days, and endless affection.

She has a whole lifetime ahead of her, and we hope it will be filled with kindness, security, and people who will cherish her as she grows.

Laverne has already been through enough. Now she deserves her very own happily ever after. Could you be the one to give it to her?

Please remember that adoption bios are only a snapshot of each animal. Reach out to our Adoption Team for additional information about Laverne and to learn if she may be the right fit for your home.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
